title: Book of Enoch (Ge'ez MS)
shelf_note: A three-column Ethiopic parchment manuscript of 1 Enoch (end of the Parables, start of the Astronomical Book), as catalogued. No tradition or collections are given to test it against.
structure_note: pages_translated is 0 in the structure counts but 310 in the book field, so the two counters disagree (E2). The image shows pencil foliation, and page record 21 carries folio '9', so about 12 front images (covers or flyleaves) come before it and only rectos are numbered (190 of 398). The 17 backsteps and 14 repeats are most likely misread or verso-assigned folio numerals, not a splice. I cannot confirm that from one page.

pages.layout: three columns of Ge'ez script; a rubricated (red) section heading with red numerals in column 3; small red paragraph marks between the columns

ocr_errors.problem: From about line 27, the OCR of column 2 leaves the leaf. Enoch's cry and blessing, the Head of Days coming to him, and the address 'You are the son of man who was born to righteousness...' (1 En 71:11-16) are missing. Invented lines ('ወርኢኩ፡ ኵሎ፡ ምስሌሆሙ፡ በቃለ፡ መዐዛ፡ ይባርኩ...') stand in their place.
The lower half of column 3, after the heading, is largely garbled ('ሰመስ / ኰታ፡ ውፅአታ፡', 'ዘእምጌቤ፡ ሁ፡ ዘንፋሰ፡ ሰላ'), though the hand is legible.
'the third [parable] of Enoch. And it came to pass' is misread as 'which I saw'. The next line, 'ምድረ፡ ገጸ፡ ተሐለሰ', is also wrong for 'ምድኅረ፡ተለዐለ'.
'between north and west' misread. The next line's 'ንሣእኩ፡ እኰበ፡ በላእክተ፡' is for 'ነሥኡ፡ አሕባለ፡ መላእክት' (the angels took cords).
'course' is read as 'order'. The red numerals inside the heading are dropped, and five lines are tagged as heading where only the first two are rubricated.

tr_errors.problem: The OCR's omission carries into the English. Enoch's blessing, the Head of Days' approach, and the declaration that Enoch is the Son of Man (the climax of the Parables) are absent. 'With you' then has no antecedent, and nothing marks the gap.

book_verdict: The right leaf, a genuine 16th-century Ethiopic Enoch, but the OCR drops about 12 lines of column 2, the passage where Enoch is named Son of Man (1 En 71:11-16), and puts invented text in their place. The English silently loses it. The rest of column 3 is translated from the standard text, not from the garbled OCR.
